billing.faq49A1: Iyo ugiye kwishyura ugomba kwemeza ikarita ya banki binyuze muri Stripe — birasabwa, ariko nta kiguzi kishyurwa mu minsi 7 kandi ubona uburyo bwuzuye. Iyo igerageza rirangiye, €49/ukwezi bishyurwa byikora. Kuraho mbere y'uko iminsi 7 irangira kandi nta kiguzi uzishyura na gato.
billing.faq49A2: Igice cy'imodoka yitwara yonyine: gushakisha no gusesengura ibyerekezo, kohereza abakiriya runaka, UGC studio, Chrome extension, Publisher hamwe n'igishushanyo mbonera cy'ibikubiye, imodoka yitwara yonyine na Gallery. AI generation ubwayo ntabwo irimo — ikora binyuze mu kwiyandikisha kwawe (Google Flow, NotebookLM, HeyGen) cyangwa API keys zawe, kandi wishyura abafatanyabikorwa mu buryo bweruye ku biciro byabo.
billing.faq49A3: Abafatanyabikorwa bagurisha amafaranga yo kwiyandikisha bihendutse cyane kuruta amasegonda amwe binyuze muri API: Veo ku kwiyandikisha kwa Google AI bihendutse inshuro 2-10, HeyGen avatars bihendutse inshuro 3. Kandi NotebookLM nta API rusange ifite na gato — kwiyandikisha gusa. Extension ikora akazi mu buryo bwikora muri konti zawe bwite, iguha uburyo bworoshye bwa API ku biciro byo kwiyandikisha. Imibare nyayo iri mu mbonerahamwe no mu kibarwa hejuru.
billing.faq49A4: Bibiri birahagije kugirango utangire: Google AI Pro (€21.99/ukwezi — Flow video + NotebookLM hamwe n'imipaka minini) na HeyGen Creator ($29/ukwezi — hafi iminota 30 ya Avatar IV). Buri serivisi ifite n'imipaka y'ubuntu (Flow — 50 credits/umunsi, NotebookLM — 3 overviews/umunsi, HeyGen — 3 videos/ukwezi), bityo ushobora kugerageza pipeline nta kwiyandikisha na gato.
billing.faq49Q5: Nshobora gukorana na API keys gusa?
billing.faq49A5: Yego. Huza keys zawe (Google Veo, FAL/Kling, Runway, OpenAI, ElevenLabs, HeyGen, Claude) muri Settings kandi serivisi izakora nazo mu buryo bweruye, nta extension ikenewe. Uzishyura izo serivisi ku biciro byazo. Inzira zivangwa mu buryo bwikora: avatars ku kwiyandikisha, voice-over binyuze muri API, urugero.
billing.faq49A6: Hejuru kuri iyi page, mu gace ka “Gahunda yawe”, buto “Zimya kwisubiramo byikora” iragaragara mu gihe umukoresha akiri muri gahunda. Igihe cyishyuwe ntigisubizwa, ariko uburenganzira bwo gukoresha burakomeza kugeza igihe kirangiye. Niba ubizimije mu gihe cyo kugerageza, ntuzishyurizwa na gato. Ushobora kongera kubyemera igihe icyo ari cyo cyose mbere y’uko igihe kirangira.
billing.faq49A7: Yego. Injiza kode y’amapromos hejuru — igabanyirizwa rizakoreshwa mu kwishyura Premium binyuze kuri Stripe.
billing.disclaimer49: TrendTraffic ntabwo ifitanye isano na Google, HeyGen, ElevenLabs cyangwa Blotato. landing.featIntro: VibeVox ikora mu mushakisha wawe. Kora icyumba cy'inama ukoresheje gukanda 1, kora kopi y'umurongo, hanyuma uwohereze kuri mugenzi wawe kuri WhatsApp cyangwa Telegram — bahita bahura, kandi bombi bumvana bahinduriwe mu rurimi rwabo kavukire. Nta kwiyandikisha bisabwa kuri mugenzi wawe.
landing.featLearnText: AI Learning Hub ihindura imvugo z'umwihariko wawe n'imvugo z'uturere 96 — Icyarabu cya Misiri, Icyesipanyoli cya Amerika y'Epfo. Mu isaha 1 gusa yo gukoresha.
landing.featPriceText: Igiciro cyo hasi cyane ku isoko ry'ubuhinduzi bwa rimwe. Wishyura gusa iminota yahinduwe — nta kwiyandikisha cyangwa amasezerano y'umwaka.
landing.featRolloverText: Amafaranga atarakoreshwa yikururira mu kwezi gutaha. Iyo amaze kwishyurwa, iminota iba iyawe nta gihe ntarengwa.
landing.featShareText: Ohereza umurongo binyuze kuri WhatsApp cyangwa Telegram — mugenzi wawe ahita ahura mu mushakisha we. Nta App Store, ishami rya IT, cyangwa gushyiraho. Ikora kuri buri gikoresho.
landing.featVoiceText: Amajwi ya HD Aoede na Charon. Gemini ihindura amajwi mu buryo bwa direct — nta STT→inyandiko→TTS. Gutinda kuri munsi ya 0.5 isegonda, ikiganiro gitembera neza.
landing.finalSub: Iyandikishe mu munota. Iminsi 7 ya mbere ku buntu.
landing.heroKicker: AI ubuhinduzi bwa rimwe ku biganiro bya videwo
landing.heroLead: Umuhinduzi wa rimwe w'impande zombi ku nama za videwo n'iguhamagara kuri SIP mu ndimi zirenga 100. Amajwi ya HD, gutinda kuri munsi ya 0.5 isegonda, €0.17 gusa ku munota.
landing.hintsText: Mu guhamagara kuri SIP, AI yandika ikiganiro mu gihe nyacyo kandi ikagaragaza ibisubizo byateguwe ku muyobozi. Nyuma yo guhamagara — ibibazo by'ingenzi, ibitera, n'ibimenyetso bihita bijya muri CRM (Chatwoot, Questflow). Huza na Zadarma, Twilio, n'indi SIP gateway yose.
landing.hintsTitle: Inama z'ubwenge mu gihe cyo guhamagara
landing.langsText: Uvuga ururimi rwawe — mugenzi wawe yumva ubuhinduzi mu rwe. Arasubiza — uhita umwumva muri {{lang}}. Mu buryo bumwe, nta gutinda, nta mvugo.
landing.metaDesc: TrendTraffic — shakisha ibyerekezo bya viral kuri TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, na X, isesengura ry'imbuga nkoranyambaga, gukusanya no gutunganya videwo.
landing.noBurnText: Muri SaaS isanzwe, iminota itarakoreshwa irangira buri kwezi. VibeVox ibyikururira neza mu kwezi gutaha — ntabwo utakaza isegonda na rimwe ry'igihe wishyuye.

ttLanding.f1Text: Scan amapulatifomu atatu ku bwoko n'akarere. "Kohereza abakoresha": sobanura ibicuruzwa byawe — AI izuzura abakoresha mu buryo bwikora, ihitemo amagambo y'ingenzi mu ndimi 29, kandi ibone ubwoko bufite ibyifuzo nyabyo. Imiyoboro y'abanywanyi mu rutonde rwo kureba hamwe n'amateka y'ibipimo.
ttLanding.f2Text: Shyiraho umurongo wa videwo iyo ari yo yose ya TikTok, Instagram, cyangwa YouTube — Gemini izayisesengura frame ku yindi: hook, umuvuduko, imiterere, amagambo. Isesengura n'amagambo azajya muri galeri, kandi "TrendDNA" izayobora videwo yawe y'ahazaza mu buryo bwikora.
ttLanding.f2Title: Inzira yo gukwirakwira — frame ku yindi
ttLanding.f3Text: Uburyo bune: solo, ikiganiro cy'abantu babiri, inyandiko yawe "uko iri", icyerekezo gishingiye ku isesengura ry'ibigezweho. Imyambarire ya HeyGen yiteguye cyangwa avatar ifoto yawe, amajwi yose ya ElevenLabs harimo n'ay'abantu, uburyo bwa subtitle z'umwimerere, n'ibikoresho by'ikigo.
ttLanding.f4Text: Kugenzura ibigezweho bihindura ibyavumbuwe mu mavideo yiteguye ashingiye ku kigereranyo cyawe. Iminyururu yo kwiyandikisha ikwirakwiza mu buryo bwikora amashusho kuri amapulatifomu n'ibihe — TikTok, YouTube, na Instagram bibona ibikubiyemo ku gihe.

ttLanding.pageDescription: TrendTraffic ibona ibigezweho kuri TikTok, Instagram, na YouTube, ikabisesengura buri gace, ikegeranya amashusho ya UGC hamwe n'amashusho ya AI — hamwe no gusohora ku gihe no kuzigama AI kugeza inshuro 4.
ttLanding.priceBody: Premium — kwinjira byuzuye kuri modules zose. Iminsi 7 ya mbere y'ubuntu, nta kiguzi, hagarika igihe icyo aricyo cyose.
ttLanding.savBody: Chrome extension yacu ihuriweho ihuriza serivisi za AI ikoresheje ubwiyandikishe bwawe busanzwe aho gukoresha API credit billing. Kandi urufunguzo rwawe (BYOK) — Gemini, ElevenLabs, TikHub, Blotato — rukora neza, nta kiguzi cy'umuhuza.
ttLanding.stBody: Gushakisha ibigezweho, isesengura rya videwo zikwirakwira cyane, amashusho y’abantu, amajwi, uduce tw’amagambo, videwo zikozwe n’ubwenge bw’imashini, no kuzishyira ahagaragara byikora—byose hamwe. Huza serivisi zawe bwite cyangwa ubone ubunyamuryango maze wishyure mu buryo buhendutse cyane kuri wewe.

ttLanding.step1Text: Icyuma cyacu gisikana TikTok, Instagram, na YouTube bishingiye ku byo ukora, akarere, n’ururimi. AI yacu igena ibyo abantu benshi bakunda n’amagambo y’ingenzi, ikabishyira ku rwego bitewe n’uko bikenewe cyane.
ttLanding.step2Text: Isesengura rya Gemini risenya videwo zikwirakwira cyane mu duce tw’ingenzi, umuvuduko, n’imiterere. Ubona TrendDNA—resept y’icyumba cyawe cya videwo, hamwe n’uduce tw’amagambo y’umwimerere.
ttLanding.step3Text: AI studio yacu ikora videwo z’amashusho y’abantu: imiterere yateguwe cyangwa ishusho y’umuntu ifashwe ku ifoto yawe, amajwi ya ElevenLabs mu ndimi 29, uduce tw’amagambo, n’ibikoresho bya brand. Iforomati 9:16 na 16:9.
ttLanding.step4Text: Autopilot igenzura ibigezweho kandi igahuza videwo ikoresheje imiterere yateguwe, mu gihe Publisher izitegura mu minsi 35 mbere: 9:16 kuri TikTok, 16:9 kuri YouTube.

storyboard.genIntroFlow: Flow engine (igice-cyikora): kura ibikoresho bya chunk, bikore muri Google Flow (Omni Flash, 9:16, "keep original sound"), bika clip "To Gallery" ukoresheje extension — hanyuma uyihambire hano. Tuzahuriza ijwi rya chunk ubwacu.
storyboard.genIntroOmni: Omni Flash engine: gukora rimwe kuri buri chunk — ishusho itangira "iba nzima" hakurikijwe prompt ya panel, n'ijwi ryawe ry'umwimerere rihurijweho. Igiciro ≈$1/chunk (~10s × $0.10) uhereye kuri Gemini key yawe. Chunk 1 mbere!

storyboard.genIntroFlow2: Flow engine — YIKORA: fungura labs.google → Flow muri browser yawe hamwe na TrendTraffic extension hanyuma ukande buto iri munsi. Extension izikora ipakiye chunk na storyboard, ishyiremo prompt, ikore, kandi isubize clip — chunk kuri chunk, ndetse no kuri videwo ndende (Flow limit ~8s/clip, niyo mpamvu ducira kuri 8s). Tuzahuriza ijwi ry'umwimerere ubwacu. Uburyo bwa manual — buto kuri karita.
